description: The image displays two pie charts illustrating the breakdown of error types in two different contexts, likely from the paper "Laying the Foundation First: Investigating the Generalization from Atomic Skills to Complex Reasoning Tasks." The top legend defines four categories: "Atomic Skill Fail" (dark teal), "Correct" (medium teal), "Reason Error" (light teal), and "Question Misunderstood" (white). The left pie chart, representing one context, is divided into four segments: "Atomic Skill Fail" at 68.0% (dark teal), "Reason Error" at 12.0% (light teal), "Correct" at 12.0% (medium teal), and "Question Misunderstood" at 8.0% (white). The right pie chart, representing the other context, is divided into three segments: "Question Misunderstood" at 55.0% (light teal), "Reason Error" at 21.0% (white), "Atomic Skill Fail" at 14.0% (dark teal), and "Correct" at 10.0% (medium teal). Both charts have percentage labels directly inside their respective slices and do not include exploded or emphasized segments. The segments in each chart are arranged in descending order of size.
